Application Data.NAME: Smith Construction Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Construction Co. specializes in a wide range of general contracting services, including residential and commercial building projects. Our operations involve the construction of new structures, remodeling, and renovation work, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and adherence to industry standards. We manage all aspects of the construction process, from initial planning and design to project completion, using skilled labor and subcontractors as needed. Additionally, we prioritize safety on job sites and maintain a robust risk management strategy, including optional coverages like Builders Risk and Inland Marine to protect our projects and equipment.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Preferred Optional Coverages
To enhance protection for general contractors and builders, the
following optional coverages are recommended:
• Builders Risk: Covers physical loss or damage to buildings under construction, including
materials, supplies, and equipment on-site or in transit.
Example: Coverage for fire damage to a partially completed commercial building.
• Inland Marine: Protects specialized contractor equipment, tools, and mobile property that
are frequently moved between job sites.
Example: Coverage for theft of expensive power tools from a locked trailer at a remote site.
• Umbrella Liability: Provides excess liability limits above primary general liability and auto
policies, offering broader protection against catastrophic claims.
• Subcontractor Default and Surety Bonds: Financial guarantees that subcontractors will
fulfill contractual obligations, reducing the risk of project delays and financial loss.
